frozen_by: implementation operator (coder-fast) per AMEND-2026-08-05-01; main-thread plan review required before formal execution
freeze_statement: Frozen BEFORE any formal scientific result (V10-10). This plan must NOT be modified after any formal result exists. Budgets, seeds, gates, caps and objective are immutable once formal data arrive. Revised per main-thread plan review REJECT (pop_size/max_gen raised from microbenchmark timing config to a scientifically adequate search using the full 600-evaluation screen budget); frozen again before any formal result.
hard_stop_rules: V10-S01: V10-0 fails q=4 reference recovery (|threshold-0.069| > 0.012)
V10-S02: V10A robust gates fail (S1 < 0.22 or S3 < 0.32)
V10-S03: planned or formal seed overlap detected
V10-S04: tuning after formal results needed
V10-S06: single execute > 24 h predicted (this plan estimates 7.7 h worst-case)
V10-S07: production decoder accesses Alice truth

estimation_arithmetic.scaling_formula: eval_sec(ns, mi) = base * (ns/500) * (mi/30), worst-case (every eval runs the full max_iter)

screen.detail: 4 searches x screen_cap_per_search 600 (hard cap; includes DE init/generations + post-screen threshold probes)

refinement.detail: 4 searches x up to 12 refinement candidates x 6 binary-search probes (approved task arithmetic)

validation.detail: 4 searches x up to 12 refinement candidates x 3 validation seeds x 6 binary-search probes (approved task arithmetic)

budget_rationale.screen_n_samples_500: Microbenchmark-validated screen resolution (v10_microbenchmark.json #1 and #2); 500 samples at q=1024 fit the RSS cap with wide margin (measured peak 222 MiB)
budget_rationale.screen_max_iter_100: Scientific sufficiency bottom line per approved task: GF(1024) p=.20 MC-DE measured convergence ~55-80 iterations at n_samples=500 (amendment trigger); max_iter=100 gives >=25% margin over the 80-iteration observation
budget_rationale.refinement_n_samples_2000: Final threshold estimates feed the S1-S4 gate decision, so they use 4x the screen sample count (2000) for statistical reliability; 2000x1024x8B = 16 MiB per message array, RSS-safe
budget_rationale.refinement_max_iter_100: Same convergence margin as the screen
budget_rationale.threshold_p_tol_0.002: Frozen binary-search tolerance (0.002 < V10-0 q=4 tolerance 0.012; gate decisions at 0.22/0.215/0.32 require finer-than-gate resolution)
budget_rationale.pop_gen_F_CR: pop=20, gen=29, F=0.5, CR=0.9: 20 (init) + 20x29 (offspring) = 600 evaluations per search, exactly the screen_cap_per_search=600 hard cap; DE/rand/1/bin (requires pop>=4, 20 satisfies); 16-dim search space (8 degree + 8 weight logit) at 600 evals is the practical maximum under the cap
budget_rationale.max_total_evaluations_2400: Screen budget = 600 x 4 searches (hard cap). Refinement (<=288 worst-case) and validation (<=864 worst-case) evaluations are separately bounded by refinement_cap 12 and the validation-seed pool
budget_rationale.sensitivity_notes: Using all 5 validation seeds instead of 3 raises the estimate to ~10.2 h; using the full default-range binary search (8 probes, p_lo=0.01 p_hi=0.49) raises it to ~9.3 h; both remain below the 24 h hard limit
budget_rationale.peak_rss_headroom: Measured process-tree peak RSS 233,103,360 B (222 MiB) at (500,30); screen (500,100) and refinement (2000,100) stay far below the frozen 3 GiB cap
